source: Progress Report (PR)  (Standardized Template for Performance Tracking)_Submissions (7)(1).xlsx
method: Provisional performance grouping from Section 2 reporting volume: below positive-department median = Underperforming; at/above median = Good Performance; zero = insufficient reporting. This does not establish actual outcome performance.
caveats: Flags are potentially overlapping and not proof of error.
Original submission status, planned/scheduled and result are distinct.
Reported student totals are not activity totals.
Submission rows with no Section 2 data remain visible as reporting gaps.
